stepBody: See image. Only type what is in the blank, do not include what is provided. Do not use spaces unless absolutely necessary. Please use double quotes (" "), instead of single quotes (' '). If you are utilizing the table, please use the numbers in order.##figure8.gif##

figureAlts.figure8.gif: The image shows a table and a fill-in-the-blank code block. The table has columns Elevation and Specimen Length. Row 1: High, 12.3; Row 2: Low, 13.1; Row 3: High, 12.0. Below the table, part (d) asks to fill in the blanks in the code to generate one value of the test statistic simulated under the null hypothesis. The code defines a function one_simulation with several blanks labeled Blank 1 through Blank 8.
